intents.text: Connect Stripe and display the product catalog
Add NEW to the 3 most recently added Stripe products

checks.name: Stripe adapter returns the complete active catalog
checks.detail: Two pages, including an inactive product, are verified independently.

checks.name: Pagination follows the last product cursor
checks.detail: The second request must use the last product ID from the first page.

checks.name: Names and prices are preserved
checks.detail: The verifier checks source values in its own process.

checks.name: Only the 3 newest products receive NEW
checks.detail: Input order is shuffled and inactive products cannot receive the badge.

limitations: Coding worker runs on the host Mac.
Stripe-compatible fixture; no live Stripe payments.
Connected Codex progress is self-reported and distinguished from managed-worker verification.
